01.question: What services does The DFL Group provide?
01.answer: The DFL Group provides end-to-end logistics and supply chain solutions, including air freight, ocean freight, inland transportation, customs clearance, warehousing, international courier and cargo services.

02.question: Does The DFL Group provide international shipping?
02.answer: Yes. We provide international logistics solutions for businesses, including air and ocean freight, international courier, customs clearance and door-to-door shipment support.

03.question: What is the difference between air freight and ocean freight?
03.answer: Air freight is generally suited to time-sensitive shipments, while ocean freight is commonly used for large or heavy cargo where cost efficiency and higher capacity matter more.

04.question: Do you offer FCL and LCL ocean freight services?
04.answer: Yes. The DFL Group provides both FCL (Full Container Load) and LCL (Less than Container Load) ocean freight solutions, depending on your shipment requirements.

05.question: Does The DFL Group provide customs clearance services?
05.answer: Yes. We provide customs clearance support to help businesses manage documentation and customs procedures for their shipments.

06.question: Do you provide door-to-door delivery?
06.answer: Yes. Door-to-door transportation and delivery solutions are available, depending on the service and destination.

07.question: Can I track my shipment?
07.answer: Yes. Shipment tracking is available for applicable services, so customers can monitor shipment movement and delivery updates.

08.question: Do you provide warehousing services?
08.answer: Yes. The DFL Group provides warehousing and logistics support to help businesses manage storage, handling and shipment movement.

09.question: Can you handle large or special cargo?
09.answer: Yes. Our logistics solutions can be customized for different cargo types, shipment sizes and transportation requirements.

10.question: How can I get a quote for my shipment?
10.answer: To get a suitable quote, you can contact The DFL Group with your origin, destination, cargo details, weight/volume and preferred mode of transport.

11.question: Which countries does The DFL Group serve?
11.answer: The DFL Group supports international logistics requirements across many global trade lanes through its international network and logistics partners.

12.question: How can I contact The DFL Group?
12.answer: For shipment inquiries, quotes and logistics support, you can reach our team through the 'Contact Us' section of the website.

1.question: What is air forwarding (air freight)?
1.answer: Air forwarding is the process of arranging and managing the transport of goods by air. It may include cargo pickup, documentation, airline booking, customs clearance, shipment tracking and final delivery.

2.question: What types of cargo can be sent by air?
2.answer: Many types of eligible goods can be sent by air, including commercial products, samples, electronics, machinery parts, e-commerce products, high-value goods and urgent shipments. Shipments must meet the requirements of the applicable airline, customs and regulatory authorities.

3.question: Do you provide customs clearance for air shipments?
3.answer: Yes. We provide customs clearance and documentation support for eligible air shipments, helping businesses manage import and export procedures more smoothly.

4.question: Can I track my air shipment?
4.answer: Yes. Shipment tracking and regular updates keep you informed about the movement and status of your cargo during transit.

5.question: Why choose air freight over ocean freight?
5.answer: Air freight is generally chosen when fast delivery is important. It is especially useful for urgent shipments, product samples, time-sensitive goods and shipments to international destinations that require short transit times.

1.question: What is surface transport (road transport) service?
1.answer: Surface transport is the movement of goods by road using trucks and other suitable vehicles. It can be used for short, medium and long-distance shipments.

2.question: What is the difference between FTL and LTL transport?
2.answer: FTL (Full Truckload) means a full truck is used for a single shipment. LTL (Less Than Truckload) allows multiple shipments to share available truck space. The right choice usually depends on the size and volume of your shipment.

3.question: Does The DFL Group provide door-to-door transport?
3.answer: Yes. We provide complete door-to-door transport with door-to-hub and hub-to-door options, based on your shipment and delivery requirements.

4.question: Can I track my road transport shipment?
4.answer: Yes. Shipment tracking helps you stay updated on your cargo during transport and provides better visibility into the progress of your shipment.

5.question: What types of surface transportation services do you provide?
5.answer: Our surface transportation services include FTL and LTL transport, first-mile and last-mile delivery, long-distance transport, route planning, vehicle coordination and door-to-door cargo movement.

1.question: What is ocean freight?
1.answer: Ocean freight means arranging the transport of goods by sea from one country to another. It may include booking the shipment, preparing documents, handling customs and coordinating delivery.

2.question: What are FCL and LCL shipping?
2.answer: FCL means Full Container Load, where a complete container is used for one shipment. LCL means Less than Container Load, where smaller shipments share space in the same container.

3.question: What types of cargo can be shipped by sea?
3.answer: Many types of commercial cargo can be transported by ocean, including machinery, raw materials, industrial products, equipment, consumer goods and other eligible commercial shipments.

4.question: Can The DFL Group help with customs clearance?
4.answer: Yes. Our team can coordinate customs clearance and documentation as part of the overall ocean freight process, making import and export shipments easier to manage.

5.question: When should I choose ocean freight?
5.answer: Ocean freight is generally a good option for large, heavy or bulky shipments. It is especially useful when you are moving large volumes of goods and speed of delivery is not the main priority.

1.question: What is customs clearance?
1.answer: Customs clearance is the process of getting goods cleared by the customs department when they are imported or exported. It involves submitting the required documents and completing formalities, after which the goods can move forward.

2.question: Which documents are required for customs clearance?
2.answer: This depends on the type of goods, the shipment and the destination. Generally, documents such as a commercial invoice, packing list and shipping documents are required. Some products may also need additional licenses, certificates or approvals.

3.question: Do you provide customs clearance for both imports and exports?
3.answer: Yes. The DFL Group provides customs clearance support for both import and export shipments. Exact requirements depend on the cargo and the rules applicable to the shipment.

4.question: Can you help with customs documentation?
4.answer: Yes. We help businesses organize and coordinate the documents needed for customs clearance. If additional documents or information are required during the process, our team also coordinates them.

5.question: What happens if there is an error in customs documents?
5.answer: If documents are incomplete or contain incorrect information, customs may ask for clarifications or additional documents. This can delay the shipment and sometimes lead to extra charges. That is why it is important to prepare documents correctly before the shipment reaches customs.

1.question: What is warehousing in logistics?
1.answer: Warehousing means storing goods safely in a designated facility until they are ready to be shipped, distributed or delivered. It is an important part of managing the movement of goods.

2.question: What types of goods can be stored in a warehouse?
2.answer: Various types of commercial and business goods can be stored depending on their size, quantity, nature and storage requirements. The suitable storage arrangement can vary from one product to another.

3.question: Do you provide inventory management support?
3.answer: Yes. Our warehousing operations may include receiving goods, storing inventory, handling stock, preparing orders and arranging dispatch. This helps businesses keep better track of their goods.

4.question: Can warehousing be combined with transportation?
4.answer: Yes. Warehousing can be combined with transportation, freight forwarding and distribution services. This allows goods to be stored in a warehouse and moved to their next destination when needed.

5.question: How can warehousing help my business?
5.answer: Good warehousing helps businesses keep their stock organized and reduces the difficulty of managing goods across different stages of the supply chain. It also makes it easier to prepare and dispatch goods when needed.

inlandTransport.overviewPara1: Road transport allows goods to be moved seamlessly over land using an extensive highway network. This mode offers unmatched flexibility with minimal geographic limits.
inlandTransport.overviewPara2: Whether sending small consignments or heavy industrial materials, road freight provides direct access to places where rail, sea or air freight cannot reach directly.
inlandTransport.ftlOptimizationDesc: Custom load-balancing for every shipment scale

modes.title: Full Truckload (FTL)
modes.subtitle: Dedicated fleet capacity
modes.description: Ideal for large shipments that require a full truck. Provides fast transit, direct delivery and maximum cargo security without any intermediate handling.

modes.title: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL)
modes.subtitle: Shared space & cost efficiency
modes.description: Perfect for smaller shipments where consignments from multiple customers share truck capacity, significantly reducing overall transit costs.
features: Pay only for the volume used

inlandTransport.whyUsDesc: The DFL Group provides seamless, door-to-door road transport services, simplifying the entire supply chain process for our clients.
